summary: All claimed bounds follow under the stated hypotheses. Domination transfers both absolute first and second moments and yields V+(m-mu)^2 <= M s^2. The scalar input reused from accepted fact 3c78088dd84bbbdf is a general log-concave density height inequality, independent of that fact's mixed-body symmetry and covariance assumptions; its normalization is correctly mapped to the present reference density g and its variance s^2. Bobkov and Ledoux's December 19, 2016 primary monograph, independently checked through the coauthor's university-hosted copy, states the required upper bound in Proposition B.2, equation (B.7), printed page 114, PDF index 113. The height bound, Tonelli tail integration, mean balance, and Cauchy-Schwarz give R >= L^4/(4M^3); the two cases R <= 1/2 and R > 1/2 yield the stated constant. Reflection proves the left bound with the correct mean and unchanged domination constant. Null mass of a singleton establishes every endpoint version. Zero cap masses and M=1 are covered by the same argument. The explicit application alias preserves the original probability normalization and mean and makes no unsupported mixed-integer admissibility assertion. No errors or gaps were found.
